header.props: title, left: back|close|none|logo, pill, avatar → Account
header.behavior: Back/close always 44pt; large title on tab roots

chips.props: options (values), labels, selected, multi, dots, label
chips.behavior: Single or multi select; local state + onChanged; the session holds values, labels are translated

segmented.behavior: The session holds values, labels are translated

radio.props: items(label, value, sub, badge), selected, label
radio.behavior: Drives radio-based branches; the session holds the item value

field.props: label, value, unit, hint, error, placeholder, kind, options, values
field.behavior: Error text says how to fix; kinds: text number email password phone date select multiline search; a select with options opens a list and the session holds the value

slider.props: label, value, min, max, minLabel, maxLabel, color

card.props: variant plain|dark|dark2|coral|mint|urgent|warn|flat, tag, eyebrow, title, text, accent, onTap, cta, children

list.props: title, rows(label, sub, value, lead, pill, danger, onTap)

tiles.props: columns, tiles(label, value, sub, program|glyph, selected, onTap)

chart.props: values, color, title, unit, missing, target, band, labels, caption, tag, onTap
chart.behavior: Missing days drawn hatched, never zero

button.props: label, onPressed, variant primary|rescue|secondary|danger|lime|white|ghostDark, small, arrow, needs, countLabel, emptyLabel
button.behavior: Disabled when onPressed is null; with needs (TGatedButton) disabled until that input has a value, and the label can count a list

calendar.props: month, selected, window, today, key, ym
calendar.behavior: With a key: a real month calendar in the app (current month, previous/next, tap to choose, accessible day labels), the chosen day is the session value yyyy-MM-dd; the design in the preview

nativeslot.behavior: Platform view registered for id (TNativeSlot.register) in the app; labelled placeholder of the same height in preview, tests and other platforms
